annotations.title: Get the link that invites or revokes members

description: Answers `url`, the member invitations page of the team, where a signed-in owner or admin invites an address as an `admin` or `member`, which mails it a link to accept that expires after 14 days, and revokes a pending invitation. `email` and `role` fill in the invite form. Needs the owner or admin role.
name: memberInvitationsLink
title: Get the link that invites or revokes members
